summary: Proceed with Play Store upload for Version 14.

existing_features.title: Update the Play Store packaging/release guidance to explicitly reference Version 14 (not Version 13) everywhere it appears in project state and repository documentation, while keeping all existing URLs, paths, and filenames unchanged unless they are inaccurate.

Ensure the in-app "View Complete Build Guide" action in the Play Store publishing section continues to open the static guide at `/play-store-build-guide.html` in production builds, and that the guide renders correct origin-derived URLs at runtime (manifest, assetlinks, privacy policy).

Harden the Bubblewrap helper script workflow (`frontend/scripts/twa/bubblewrap-release.sh`) for the Version 14 Play Store submission flow so it reliably produces a signed AAB (for Play Console) and, when available, an APK (for testing), and prints explicit next steps for updating `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json` and redeploying the frontend.
